what_went_wrong: Llama 0.2915 kJ for 307.4 kJ (max useful work nFE); verifier: arithmetic slip.

input.stem:
In a direct methanol fuel cell operating at 298 K, liquid methanol is electrochemically oxidized by oxygen to carbon dioxide and liquid water, involving 6 electrons transferred in the cell reaction per molecule of methanol oxidized. During steady operation, the measured cell EMF is 1.18 V when 0.45 mol of methanol is completely consumed.

Take Faraday constant, F = 96500 C mol⁻¹.

Calculate the magnitude of the maximum useful (non-PV) work obtainable (kJ) from this process under the given operating conditions.
Give the answer in kJ.
